evidence.outcome: currently trusts client URLs, overwrites archives/mod-list directly, and lacks lock/uninstall/profile/bulk transaction
existing mod routes already inherit authenticated CSRF and mutation audit/role filters
additive app_state profiles and same-filesystem transaction journal are viable
Mods has search/install/update/toggle but no role gating/uninstall/profile/bulk UX

next_slice.summary: Implement additive domain models, transaction-safe ModService/Portal resolver, routes, compact Mods UI, and focused tests before exposing destructive controls.

result: Expand ModService as the sole mod-state owner with a mutation gate, crash-recoverable journal, staged same-filesystem transaction, and persisted desired profiles. Add uninstall, bulk update, profile create/apply/delete, and recursive server-side Mod Portal dependency resolution with cycle/conflict/missing/version validation. Preflight all work, verify archives/info.json, atomically commit mod-list/state, rollback on failure, and reject enabled dependents on uninstall by default. Keep viewers read-only, admin/owner mutations, CSRF/audit, stopped-server guards, and explicit UI plans/confirmations.
